trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the Platinum trophy and it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing extra to do for it specifically. Expect to finish the five-chapter story first (around 60-80 hours), then work through the 100% checklist and the remaining activities, collectibles and crime trophies. There are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies, so the Platinum is long rather than hard, and no cheat may be active while you chase it, since cheats disable trophies.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion and this Gold trophy unlocks. The full checklist appears in the Progress menu (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion) after you finish the story, but progress you make during the story already counts toward it. trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Push Square counts 397 stunts in the game in total, so you need just over half of them, which makes this a grind rather than a completionist chore. The fastest approach is to play normally through the story, then mop up the remainder at marked stunt jumps and ramps in free roam after the credits. There is no requirement to do all 250 in one session, so the counter builds up over the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types in the game once. Push Square confirms there are nine activities in total, covering things like the Shooting Range, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and drone races, so this trophy is really about sampling everything Leonida offers. You do not need to win or finish any of them well: starting and completing a single attempt of each type is enough. It is best done during the story playthrough, trying each activity the first time you come across it, and your progress can be checked in the Progress menu.

Pick three shops close together in Vice City, bring your partner along, and hit them in rapid succession. trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so find one in free roam, stop it, and crack it open. The usual approach is to block the truck with your own vehicle, take out the guards, and blow or pry open the rear doors to get the cash. Expect a wanted level the moment the robbery starts, so have a fast escape car ready and a route away from the police. Based on the official description, the escape is part of the requirement, so the trophy only pops once you have lost the heat. This is a quick trophy that can be done any time in free roam.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida. This trophy tracks the named areas you visit across the state, from Vice City and Ocean Beach to the countryside towns, swamps and islands, and it only pops when the whole map has been covered. Your exploration progress is tracked in the Progress menu, so check it regularly to see which areas are still unvisited. The best approach is a systematic sweep in free roam after the story: drive, fly and sail through each region, and combine the trip with the WAiNK locations for You WAiNKer!, the vehicle scanning for Whip It Good, and the meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude, since all of them reward covering the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. AlcastHQ counts nine gangs, so you need nine robberies, one per gang. Each gang runs its own illegal operations, such as drug labs, chop shops or smuggling dens, and you need to find and hit one operation for every gang on the list. Your progress is tracked in the Progress menu, so check which gangs you have already hit before planning the next one. Expect armed resistance at each site, and a wanted level after the robbery, so bring weapons and an escape vehicle. This is a cleanup-phase trophy best done after the story, when the whole map is open.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Based on the official description only, this means going to a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Beach, ordering a cocktail, and drinking it while looking out over the water. No guide had confirmed the exact trigger at launch, so the simplest reading is the right one: find a bar with a sea view on Ocean Beach, sit or stand where the view is, and order a cocktail. Try the beachfront bars in the evening, when the view is at its best, and if one spot does not work, try another bar along the beach. This is a hidden trophy, so it stays invisible in your list until it pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Based on the official description only, this means driving a car straight through the glass front of a vehicle showroom, the way the classic GTA trailers did it. Find a dealership with a big glass storefront in Vice City, get a fast car, and drive it through the window from inside the showroom or straight through from the street. Expect a wanted level and an alarm, so be ready to drive away fast once you are through. This is a hidden trophy, so it stays invisible in your list until it pops, and it can be attempted at any time in free roam.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Based on the official description only, this means going to that specific bowling alley and playing a game of bowling there, following through on your throw. Find the Kolt & Associates alley in Vice City, start a game, and bowl a full game. Bowling is one of the nine activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None. No guide had confirmed the exact trigger at launch, but the description points clearly at playing bowling at this named alley, so a full game there is the thing to try. This is a hidden trophy, so it stays invisible in your list until it pops.

trophies.guide: This trophy's description is deliberately vague, and PowerPyx lists it among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch, so this guide is based on the official description only. The wording points at a story moment involving Jason and Lucia's partnership reaching a wide audience, most likely a scene where the pair become famous or go viral in Leonida. The practical advice is to simply play through the story: hidden story-moment trophies like this one tend to pop on their own during the campaign. If it has not popped by the end of the story, it is worth checking the fan guides again, since the community will have pinned down the trigger by then.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices that change your Criminal Profile. AlcastHQ lists a count of 500 actions for this trophy, which matches the PSN-tracked counter for choices that shift your criminal profile, though this figure comes from a single source and is unconfirmed. In practice, this means playing the game the way a criminal would: robberies, heists, crimes and decisions that push your profile in one direction or another all build the counter over time. It is a long grind that happens naturally across a full playthrough, so do not chase it directly: finish the story, do the side content and the crime trophies, and check the counter in the Progress menu. It should pop during the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by. Based on the official description only, this means attacking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, the drive-by equivalent of a bowling strike. Get a melee weapon, hop in a car with your partner driving or drive yourself, and swing at pedestrians or enemies as you pass them. PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known at launch, so the exact number of targets is unconfirmed, but the description clearly points at a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Try it in free roam on a quiet street, and be ready for a wanted level if the police see it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash you earn from heists and big robberies, and they need to be cleaned through contacts before they count as spendable income. Run heists and bank vault robberies to build up a stock of Marked Bills, then launder them through your contacts in batches. The counter tracks the total laundered, so it builds up over the whole playthrough and there is no need to do it all at once. This pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal and the other robbery trophies, and the clean money feeds straight into the spending trophy, Treat Yo Self.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Every purchase counts: clothes, weapons, ammo, food, vehicle upgrades and anything else you buy in a shop. The counter tracks total spending across the whole playthrough, so it builds up naturally as you gear up for missions and robberies. To finish it off in the cleanup phase, spend the clean money from laundering Marked Bills on the most expensive items you still need, such as high-end weapons and vehicle modifications. There is no requirement to spend it all in one shop or one session, so just keep buying what you need and the trophy will pop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties in Leonida. Push Square and AlcastHQ both count eight garages, each with one parking spot, and you need to buy every one of them. Garages are bought through the in-game property or real-estate system, and they cost a significant amount of money, so this trophy belongs to the late game, after you have built up cash from heists and laundering. Buy the garages as you can afford them during the story, and finish the last ones in the cleanup phase. Owning garages also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for the Scooter Bros app, so it pairs well with On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app is the in-game vehicle service, and registering a vehicle means adding a car, bike or other vehicle you own or have found to the app. Based on the official description, any ten vehicles count, so drive a variety of cars into your garage and register each one through the app. The easiest approach is to collect ten different vehicles during normal play, register them as you go, and finish the last few in the cleanup phase with cheap cars from around Vice City. This pairs well with Whip It Good, which asks you to discover 100 vehicles, and with Little Boxes, which gives you garages to store them in.
